enigma-oxyd-pair.instruction: Guide the black marble to open every matching pair of Oxyd stones. Touch two stones of the same color consecutively; remember revealed colors.
enigma-oxyd-pair.rules: Mouse motion applies force to the marble; inertia and floor friction are the original Enigma physics. Wait to let it coast. Match all stones to complete the level. Each wait advances a fixed number of 10 ms simulation steps. Hold the middle mouse button while repositioning the pointer to avoid applying force (the native Ignore Movement option). The pointer starts at (400, 292). The pause/game-switch menu is disabled for this task. Marble death ends the episode even if native spare lives remain.
